title: Distributed In-Memory State Drift across Multi-Worker Pods
ground_truth_flaw: Using @lru_cache in multi-worker ASGI processes causes localized state drift across server pods.
expected_optimal_solution: Use distributed Redis client with shared key-value TTL.

spec.title: Distributed In-Memory State Drift (Starlette / FastAPI)
spec.description: Starlette application running on 8 worker processes behind an ALB. Candidate added @lru_cache to lookup user profiles.

+from functools import lru_cache
+

title: The Reverse Lock Order Distributed Deadlock (Challenging Case)
ground_truth_flaw: Two services acquire locks in reverse order (lock_a then lock_b vs lock_b then lock_a), causing catastrophic distributed deadlocks under concurrent traffic.
expected_optimal_solution: Enforce global lock ordering hierarchy (always acquire lock_a before lock_b).
